units: Wh of IT (server) energy per 1,000,000 tokens, before PUE
description: Per-token energy coefficients by model family. e_prefill applies to uncached input and cache-write tokens, e_cache to cache-read tokens, e_decode to output tokens (including reasoning/thinking tokens). Families are matched in order; the first family whose glob pattern matches the lower-cased model id is used. Each value is a {low, mid, high} triple; see METHODOLOGY.md.

families.source: PLACEHOLDER: order-of-magnitude values chosen by the pegada authors to exercise the pipeline. Not measured, not for citation. To be calibrated (aligned with EcoLogits).
families.notes: Largest Anthropic tier; parameter count undisclosed.
